sources.summary: Since its founding in 1990, Edifica has established itself as the most significant exhibition of its kind in Latin America. Organized biennially by the Chilean Chamber of Construction and Fisa, this major event serves as the primary meeting point for the entire industry value chain, bringing together leading suppliers, professional visitors, and representatives from both the public and private sectors.
